question: Can a holdout corpus of fresh m048 trajectories (seeds 100-119) be generated with the post-fix generator for clean holdout validation of cohort-derived priors?
hypothesis: The post-fix generator produces seeds 100-119 with schema/units consistent with the original 0-99 cohort, usable via lib.traj_load.
narrative_md: Generated 20 holdout trajectories (m048 seeds 100-119) with the post-fix generator, symlinked into the survey workspace and reachable via lib.traj_load.load_truth. Same code path / schema / inertia tensor as the 0-99 cohort; the master NPZ is left unmodified so buggy-era consumers are unaffected. This is the holdout test set required before any cohort-derived prior can be claimed operational. Produces ground-truth trajectories rather than consuming truth as an inversion input.
